The '''''Lokani Dawn''''' was a [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ship]] that carried its passengers in [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]]. It was constructed and launched by the [[Human/Legends|people]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> around [[25,200 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> not long after the fall of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. The progress of the ''Lokani Dawn'' was watched by generations of [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] for almost two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] until an undetected [[Asteroid/Legends|meteor]] shower disintegrated the starship around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Lokani Dawn'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
